newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA'S POST OFFICE DELAYS PRICE RISES - RADIO.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA'S POST OFFICE DELAYS PRICE RISES - RADIO.

text.p: South Africa's state-owned Post Office will hold off on planned price rises of around 40 percent to allow time for a second round of talks with disgruntled business leaders, national radio said on Sunday.
It said the post office postponed the increases, originally due on Monday, after talks with the Direct Marketing Association (DMA) which represents firms that rely heavily on the post.
Post Minister Jay Naidoo also attended the talks, a second round of which will now be held on Tuesday.
The DMA had warned that businesses would have to find alternative ways to reach their customers if the post office, much criticised for erratic services, went ahead with the rises.
Naidoo said a week ago moves to restructure the loss-making post office were already starting to bear fruit but that much still had to be done to improve services to the general public.
